title: Schema errors
hypothesis: A renamed required column is detected and a mapping proposed but not applied without approval; prices are fixed by try_cast and quarantine; the missing optional table disables its features.
conclusion: Detected at: renamed_required_column -> ingest, price_as_text_with_symbols -> clean, dropped_optional_table -> clean. 2 of 2 scored faults detected; the clean baseline passed: False. Prices written as text were not fixed by try_cast and quarantine: detected at clean; clean_ok=False approvals=0 auto_applied=0. 0 mappings were applied without a person. 0 conditions lost rows silently (cleaning reported success while the row accounting did not balance). Detection rate is reported against the baseline on purpose: a detector that flagged everything would otherwise score perfectly.
limitations: `register_version` returns early on an identical checksum, before it validates anything. That is correct idempotence, but it means a file whose bytes were registered before a contract existed for its dataset is never re-validated. This experiment sidesteps it by registering each condition under a fresh dataset name; a deployment would need a re-validation pass when a contract is introduced or changed. Not a defect, but not covered either.
Only profile and clean are run, so what the feature stage does with a missing optional table - the 'disables its features' half of the hypothesis - is not measured here.
